rules: Every active repair transaction has exactly one canonical active owner path resolved through the topology selected by CURRENT-AUTHORITY.
PROSE is retired and cannot receive a new repair transaction; genuinely current prose/document integration failures route to DOCUMENTS.
Historical Prose repair evidence remains immutable and does not transfer PASS, repair budget or qualification authority to Documents.
No repair transaction may create or transfer A-01 PASS, promotion, publication or production authority.
SUBJECT_FAILURE may create product repair work; admission/window/dependency/human/author/private/native/external/control-plane outcomes route to their truthful boundary.
An active owner chat or Second Shift worker checks its repair inbox after current-authority reconciliation and before unrelated build-ahead.
Changed candidate bytes require a new exact SHA and deterministic prequalification PASS on that same SHA before A01_REQUEUE_READY.
Completed/superseded/dead-letter transactions move to history; history is never erased.
